# LookForIt

> LookForIt is a curated directory for discovering the best AI tools, useful websites and online resources. Every listing is manually reviewed and verified, with no invented listings. It lists 153 verified AI tools in 20 categories, 20 free browser tools and 43 articles.

- Site: https://www.lookforit.xyz/
- Sitemap: https://lookforit.xyz/sitemap.xml
- Contact: syedsenterprises@gmail.com
